card.name: Digits inside numeric ranges and tables
card.fires_on: The decimal point or a digit partway through a number that is the upper end of a range or table row, such as "0.2 mCi to 0.5 mCi" or "405-494". It fires most on the point after a leading 0 in a dose range.

modes.label: Decimal point in dose range
modes.description: The point after 0 in the upper value of a radioactivity dose range.

modes.description: A middle digit of a number in a weight or value band in a dosing table.

modes.label: Digit in ratio
modes.description: The last digit of a ratio such as 67:33.
